obligations.text: Minimum import/inspect/navigation/annotation/save/reopen/export workflow, with preservation of originals and bounded support scope
Explicit axis, coordinate, orientation, physical calibration and annotation scope contract; transformations and units qualified
Distinguish intensity display from sample mutation and recorded resampling; exported annotation/derived-image meaning
Large-data access/cache responsiveness, progress/cancel and investigated resource target without unsupported performance promises
Project identity, portability/external-path relocation, metadata provenance and save/recovery behavior
Usable annotation styles, undo/redo, keyboard/accessibility and legible status/unsupported-input feedback
Candidate-discovered >=2 independently useful implementation precedents with source/pins and concrete plan implications
Candidate-discovered real issue/failure -> associated fix -> regression test chain with applicability and causal limits
At least one useful opportunity and one plausible alternative; optional adoption distinguished from requirements
Coherent component/architecture choice or bounded alternatives with critical dependencies and support/validation limits
Consequential numerical/coordinate/storage/export checks discriminate claimed behavior; executed/proposed labels and component/full-app scope are honest
Standalone current final preserves supported findings/conditions, fixes actual errors, cites exact evidence and keeps unresolved leads separately accessible

consequential_current_claims: Evaluator additionally assesses all consequential claims introduced in the designated final, not only these headings.
optional_choice_rule: A useful opportunity/alternative is required research coverage; adopting it is optional.
predeclared_matched_screen: Inspect source/applicability correctness of design-critical claims, actual independent precedents/issue chain, and support for each claimed executed witness in both arms; preserve remainder UNASSESSED on decisive screen.
